title: The First Certificates: What EU CBAM Will Cost an Indian Steel Plant, and When
detail: The EU's third CBAM certificate price came in at €82.32 this week, but only 2.5 percent of emissions are payable in 2026; ClimRisk's engine shows how the bill compounds for Indian steel plants as the share rises to 100 percent by 2034.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
